title: Linda Brown sees a $100,000 check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford

tellings.quote: And Linda, who was visiting her father in Atherton at that time, remembers seeing a check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford for $100,000.

plain: Linda Brown, the daughter of Townsend Brown, a scientist Michels links to early secret work on flying-saucer-like craft, remembers seeing a check for $100,000 from her father's foundation to Stanford while visiting him in Atherton, California, in the 1970s. Michels passes on her memory. It is told as a sign that Brown's research was being funded at a major research institution.
